faq.a: HEIC (High Efficiency Image Format) is Apple's default photo format on iOS 11+. It offers better compression than JPG but is not supported by all platforms.
Yes —heic2any runs entirely in your browser using WebAssembly. Your HEIC file never leaves your device.

faq.q: Why can't I open HEIC on Windows?
faq.a: Windows 10/11 need the HEIF Image Extensions codec from Microsoft Store. Alternatively, use this tool to convert HEIC to JPG for universal compatibility.
Converting HEIC to JPG at 90-100% quality preserves visual quality well. PNG is lossless. WebP offers the best quality-to-size ratio.
